newsitem.title: CHINA: China Travel mulls hotel investment.
newsitem.headline: China Travel mulls hotel investment.

text.p: China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd said on Thursday it was discussing investments in hotel projects owned by its parent China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong Ltd (CTS Holdings).

"It is involved in negotiations and conducting due diligence with respect to a number of hotels owned either in whole or in part by CTS Holdings and/or third parties," the company said in a statement.
The talks, involving hotel projects in China and Hong Kong, are preliminary and no agreements had been reached, it said.
"The company does not know when such negotiations will be concluded," it said.
China Travel added that its parent was also in negotiations to invest in bridge projects in China's Fujian and Shandong province and in Wuhan and Beijing. It said no agreement had been signed.

China Travel said it was considering various means of funding, including internal resources or the issue of convertible bonds. No decision had been made on the size and timing of the bond issue, it said.
Trading in China Travel shares is due to resume on Thursday following a one-day trading suspension.
